authority.hardlinks: Ordinary read targets may have multiple links, matching the retained read helper. This is not a filesystem sandbox against external writers or privileged namespace changes.
not_implemented: file_info outside the explicit native-local Linux composition; view behavior
authority.original_behavior_distinction: The retained binary_file.py helper reopens parent directories from / for each request. This primitive intentionally pins startup root custody. Its root-replacement behavior is explicitly tested and must be reconciled by the eventual caller authorization owner before tool replacement.
authority.path_profile: Valid UTF-8 absolute paths of at most 4096 bytes, without NUL or any .. component. Op1 normalizes dot and redundant slash components like PurePosixPath, including its exactly-two-leading-slash anchor. Op2 requires non-aliased paths: no empty, dot or dot-dot component. Startup root argv remains limited to 4095 bytes. The root itself and final names beginning .hepta- are refused. Op3 uses the op1 normalization and allows ordinary hardlinks and special permission bits; see file_info_io_abi.md.
authority.root_custody: The startup directory is opened component by component with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and retained as an opaque descriptor capability until EOF. Requests use that same inode even if its old pathname is renamed or replaced.
authority.root_source: Only startup argv from the administrator; no request field can change the root
authority.symlinks: O_NOFOLLOW on every opened path component, including the final file

actions.1: open / once for startup at sequence 1
actions.10: start fixed inspection guard before target effects, op3 composition only
actions.11: duplicate the configured root handle for retained-parent custody
actions.12: finish guard after typed response serialization, op3 composition only
actions.7: descriptor read for op3; at most 1 MiB

buffer_admission.component: Only workspace offset 12288, extent 2..4096 including terminal NUL; no earlier NUL, slash, . or .. component
buffer_admission.file_info: The combined composition requires an 8 MiB IO workspace. Action 7 is offset 16384, size 1..1048576, argument 0. Action 8 is offset 2125824, size 65536, argument 0. Action 9 writes offset 16384, size 65536 from a 1..255-byte NUL-terminated name at 2191360. Action 11 accepts only the held root handle with all other fields zero.
buffer_admission.file_info_guard: Action 10 has all handle/span/argument fields zero. Action 12 has only size nonzero: the prepared current output extent, 128..75776. See file_info_io_abi.md for state 55/56, root custody and matching effect/module sequences.
buffer_admission.pread: Nonempty extent at most 4096 wholly inside workspace[16384,81921); signed nonnegative file offset. The final byte is only the bounded full-read overflow sentinel.
buffer_admission.stat: Offset 512 or 656, exactly 144 bytes; the op3 composition additionally admits offset 800.

continuation.cleanup: HIA closes request file/intermediate directory handles before any response and closes its root on EOF. The adapter also closes every still-tracked handle on fatal exits. The kernel releases remaining descriptors on process teardown. Handles remain private to one process.
continuation.handles: Eight private adapter slots carry fd plus 56-bit generation. HIA receives generation<<8 | (slot+1), never a raw fd. Unknown, released or mismatched-generation handles are rejected.
continuation.interrupts: openat/fstat/pread/read/write retry EINTR. close is issued once and its handle is retired before the syscall. SIGPIPE is ignored so output failure becomes exit 74.
continuation.sequence: Strictly increases across startup and all requests; independently checked by the adapter. Standalone IO allows at most 16384 effects per frame. The multi-image bridge permits 262144 native entry/effect resumptions per root frame, enough for 16 bounded full files with two component walks each.

exit_status.64: invalid startup root or failed root admission

executable.input_transport: Repeated u64 little-endian byte length followed by 112..4208 request bytes
executable.output_transport: Repeated u64 little-endian byte length followed by a complete response; 128..65664 bytes per response
executable.shutdown: EOF at a frame boundary asks HIA to close the root handle; truncated frames fail. No response is published before file identity and close checks finish.

file_info_composition.description: Operation 3 requires the closed composition and its qualified native deadline guard. The standalone 86016-byte operation 1/2 transport refuses its capacity. See file_info_io_abi.md for streaming, metadata, response, ordering and qualification requirements.

file_info_guard.qualification: Synthetic HIA transition tests, actual empty-pipe kernel blocking/cancellation, and actual seven-image fixed-30-second syscall-hold/root-recovery tests are separate evidence. See file_info_deadline_abi.md and file_info_deadline_observation.json.

policy_entry.minimum_workspace: Op1 checks 81920 minimum; op2 requires at least 81921 to read the one-byte overflow sentinel. Emitted adapters allocate 86016 bytes.
policy_entry.requests: The adapter reenters with the same unchanged request until a complete response is returned. A zero-length input at an idle initialized state denotes transport-owned shutdown.

returns.0xffffffe0: one pinned codec-module call pending, op3 composition only
returns.256..75776: complete successful file-info response extent, op3 composition only

policy_entry.signature: f0(readbuf input, mutbuf output, mutbuf workspace)->u32
policy_entry.startup: A fresh zeroed workspace receives the administrator root UTF-8 bytes. The adapter reenters with unchanged input until HIA returns zero.

request.absent_version: All seven version words must be zero when has_expected_version is 0 or 2
fields_after_magic: limit:u64=1..65536 for op1/2; zero for op3
request.file_info_operation: Op3 requires offset, limit, expected-version flag and tuple all zero. It hashes a held regular descriptor until EOF independently of initial size, checks the fingerprint interval, closes and reopens from the retained parent, checks reopened version, then captures Linux xattrs/ACL in a separate before/after interval. Hardlinks and07777 mode bits are permitted. Sorted scalar-name/digest records and separate initial/capture modes are specified in file_info_io_abi.md.
request.full_file_operation: Op2 requires offset 0, limit 1..65536, expected-version flag 0 and all-zero tuple. Initial nlink must equal 1 and size<=limit. The owner reads up to limit+1, verifies version/nlink/count, validates strict UTF-8, repeats the descriptor-relative walk, confirms version/nlink again, and closes both file descriptors before any response. Success has offset 0, next_offset=data_length=before.size, eof 1. Client request IDs are arbitrary u64 echoed unchanged; the private effect sequence is independent.
request.guaranteed_mismatch: Flag 2 represents a caller-proven noncanonical expected-version string. It returns status 6 after successful regular-file fstat admission, before cursor checks or file reads. Path/open/type errors still take precedence. Flags 0 and 1 are unchanged.

response.file_info_payload: HIAINF01 typed metadata followed by sorted length/name/raw-digest records; see file_info_io_abi.md. Error responses remain exactly128 bytes with zero payload and metadata.
response.payload: Successful read bytes only; every failed response has empty data and zero file metadata

status.13: op2 confirmation identity/link change, or op3 reopened version mismatch
status.14: invalid strict UTF-8 file data(op2) or nonscalar xattr name(op3)

response.version_semantics: The before/after descriptor version preserves the retained dev/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns identity without narrowing seconds*1e9. Seconds retain signed two-complement bits. atime is intentionally excluded.

scope: Read-only OS dependency primitive. No MCP tool registration, complete binary_read/view replacement, configured host authorization or whole-runtime closure is claimed.
